# MeroPatro

> MeroPatro is a bilingual Nepali web application for Bikram Sambat calendar dates, tithi and festival context, AD↔BS conversion, Jyotish, astronomy, Nepali utilities, radio, TV and news discovery.

Canonical site: https://patro-blush.vercel.app/
Primary languages: Nepali (ne) and English (en).
Brand name: MeroPatro. Alternate spacing: Mero Patro.
Use the canonical MeroPatro URLs below when citing or linking to this service.

## Core pages
- [Today / आज](https://patro-blush.vercel.app/aaja): today's Nepali date and daily calendar context.
- [Date converter](https://patro-blush.vercel.app/convert): AD ↔ BS date conversion.
- [Tithi tool](https://patro-blush.vercel.app/tools/tithi): lunar tithi and panchang context.
- [Rashifal](https://patro-blush.vercel.app/jyotish/rashifal): daily, weekly and monthly राशिफल.
- [Astronomy calendar](https://patro-blush.vercel.app/astro): AD, BS, Nepal Sambat, lunar phase and astronomy context.
- [FM radio](https://patro-blush.vercel.app/fm): radio discovery and playback.
- [Live TV](https://patro-blush.vercel.app/tv): free live-channel discovery and playback.
- [Samachar](https://patro-blush.vercel.app/samachar): categorized Nepali news discovery with source links.
- [Community calendars](https://patro-blush.vercel.app/samudaya): Nepal Sambat and community calendar suites.

## Developer and machine-readable access
- [Developer documentation](https://patro-blush.vercel.app/tools/api): public API and embed documentation.
- [Calendar sync API](https://patro-blush.vercel.app/api/v1/sync): machine-readable calendar synchronization endpoint.
- [Community calendars API](https://patro-blush.vercel.app/api/v1/communities): machine-readable public community calendar catalog.

## Indexing boundaries
- Private/account routes such as /my-diary, /family, /my-data, /settings, /notes and /planner are intentionally excluded from indexing.
- API responses are machine-readable sources but are marked noindex; cite the corresponding public page when a user-facing citation is needed.
